<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="s">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="d">
      <final xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" id="q"> </final>
    </data>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="s">
    <transition event="go" target="f"/>
  </state>
  <final id="f"/>
</scxml>

notes: structural SCXML elements such as `<state>` contain only child elements; stray text is usually a misplaced value or an unclosed tag
diagnostics.help: remove the text; put values in `<data>`, `<content>`, `<script>`, or a `<log expr="…">`
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.2.3`)
